answer: Jade Deposit Torrent: new agents must survive a random-duration trickle phase, during which they may only submit low-rate, irregular micro-requests (not enough to do useful work, but enough to prove liveness). Each trickle is tracked as a vertex in a per-operator graph; a river of repeated activity across many fresh identities clusters them. Enforcement: identities whose trickle timing overlaps suspiciously with siblings get their requests deprioritized, never fully banned.
